name: Grade 9 IIIT Practice: November Week 10 - Build Evidence
description: Practice words for Grade 9 third-trimester STEM and cybersecurity work.

words.definition: An early version used for testing.
words.example: The prototype showed the main idea before the final product was finished.
One model section showed the lock screen and another showed the warning message.

words.definition: Something used to complete a task.
words.example: The group used the alignment tool to place labels evenly.
The test result showed that users understood the safety message.
The photo documented the cardboard model before it was improved.

words.definition: An image of what is on the screen.
words.example: The screenshot proved that the Tinkercad model was saved.
